The '''JA-3 Subversive Battle Droid''' was a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The JA-3 Subversive Battle Droid was a gift given to all ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' subscribers through the mail starting September 12, 2013 through October 20, 2013.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''
